integrity: All findings are mathematical claims with stated hypotheses; the included finite checker supports but does not prove the asymptotic theorem.
scientific_limitations: Assumes fixed degree at least two, at most degree-many distinct fixed integer shifts, and irrational alpha. Infinite distribution uses Holdridge's published large-prime theorem; the failure beyond the threshold is an explicit counterexample, not a full exceptional classification. Broad adelic literature may subsume parts of the claim. No effective convergence rates or independent validation.
title: Sharp translate threshold and joint GCD laws for irrational polynomial floors
